memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent with ADLs, uses a walking stick for outdoor walks. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 1, clock draw normal) – negative screen. falls: zero falls in last 12 months, gait slow but steady, timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk; advise daily balance exercises and supportive footwear. medicines: 9 regular (cetirizine, fluticasone nasal spray, montelukast, clobetasol cream, calcipotriol ointment, methotrexate, folic acid, methylcobalamin, vitamin D3) – polypharmacy; request Beers criteria review. mood: reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness. carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby. goals: "I want to stay active and pain‑free to attend my grandson’s school events."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Skin prick test: wheal ≥3 mm to Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus (dust mite) and grass pollen mix; negative to histamine control and saline. Interpretation: allergic sensitisation consistent with allergic rhinitis.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Allergic rhinitis – seasonal exacerbations with sneezing, nasal congestion, itchy eyes; triggered by dust mite and pollen exposure. No urticaria or angioedema.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADLs independent, occasional knee discomfort on stairs. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 – stable. falls: zero falls, gait slightly antalgic right knee, timed up‑and‑go 12 seconds – borderline risk; continue exercises, review footwear. medicines: 9 regular; methotrexate dose reduced to 5 mg weekly due to ALT rise. mood: reports improved sleep, denies depression. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I wish to walk pain‑free to the temple twice a week."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Chest X‑ray: lungs clear, cardiac silhouette within normal limits, no pleural effusion. No active infection.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been having stiffness and swelling in my left wrist for the past two weeks, worse in the mornings. It makes it hard to button my shirt and hold my teacup.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Rheumatology, Dr S. Rao, for evaluation of possible inflammatory arthritis affecting wrists and knees. Please assess for disease‑modifying therapy and advise on joint protection.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Rheumatology review: mild synovitis of left wrist, seronegative, NSAID trial recommended. No DMARD started. Advised wrist splint, physiotherapy, and follow‑up in 8 weeks. No urgent intervention needed.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for Rheumatology follow‑up with Dr S. Rao on 2026-10-20 at 10:30 am. Patient to bring wrist splint and medication list.
